thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 12/07/2018: AMOT, CMTL, TSM

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/07/2018: AMOT, CMTL, TSM
text:

GOOG, -3%
Technology stocks were in negative territory, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 slipping more than 3% just before the closing bell on Friday.
In company news, Allied Motion Technologies ( AMOT ) rose nearly 14% after it announced its acquisition of acquired electronic manufacturing company TCI LLC for $64.1 million. The purchase price was funded with existing cash plus borrowings under the company's revolving credit facility. TCI expects 2018 revenue of about $45 million, said Allied Motion in a Thursday statement.
In other sector news,
(+) Comtech Telecommunications ( CMTL ) Posts diluted EPS of $0.14 in Q1, beating analysts' estimates of a GAAP net loss of $0.06 per share in a Capital IQ poll, and reversing a net loss of $0.07 per share.
(-) Taiwan Semiconductor ( TSM ) Reportedly begins instituting austerity measures meant to prepare the contract chip maker for a difficult year ahead amid falling demand for new smartphone models
